create_grid_component: create a Grid component that generates a plane mesh with configurable size and resolution
build_grid_mesh: build a grid mesh using GenMeshPlane with specified size and resolution parameters
register_grid_model: register a grid model with the light system using position, rotation, and color properties
convert_rotation_to_angle_axis: convert an entity rotation matrix to angle and axis using Quaternion.FromMatrix and ToAngleAxis
summarize_grid_start: summarize the Grid Start method that loads a plane mesh and registers it with the light system
